[Swasthya Healthcare](https://www.swasthyahealthcare.com/) primarily manufactures and distributes its own broad portfolio of generic and specialized pharmaceutical formulations rather than acting as a named distributor for prominent third-party consumer brands. They partner with over 100 manufacturing sites and supply more than 500 medical formulations globally. [](https://swasthyahealthcare.com/facilities.php)

- **Oncology:** Trastuzumab, Rituximab, Dasatinib, Enzalutamide, Carfilzomib, and Fulvestrant.

- **Critical Care & Nephrology:** Enoxaparin Sodium, Erythropoietin, Filgrastim, and Liposomal Amphotericin B.

- **Contrast Media:** Iohexol, Iopamidol, and Gadopentetate Dimeglumine.

- **Antiretrovirals (ARV) & Metabolic:** Sofosbuvir/Velpatasvir tablets and diabetic medications.

- **General Formulations:** Cardiovascular, antibiotic, anti-inflammatory, and neurological generic tablets and capsules. [](https://in.linkedin.com/company/swasthya-healthcare)

Headquartered in Thane, Maharashtra, [Swasthya Healthcare Private Limited](https://www.swasthyahealthcare.com/) is a specialized pharmaceutical formulation, contract manufacturing (CDMO), and global export organization led by Founder and CEO Mrs. Aarti Rajesh Deshpande. It partners with over 100 accredited Indian and international manufacturing facilities holding WHO-GMP, DCGI, and NAFDAC approvals to supply more than 500 generic and specialized therapeutic formulations across 30+ countries. [](https://in.linkedin.com/company/swasthya-healthcare)

Swasthya Healthcare focuses heavily on high-end, complex, and life-saving therapeutic segments rather than standard consumer brands, spanning over 280 global marketing authorizations: [](https://www.cphi-online.com/company/swasthya-healthcare-private-limited/)

- **Oncology:** Carfilzomib (10/30/60 mg), Apalutamide 60 mg tablets, Trastuzumab, Rituximab, Enzalutamide, Dasatinib, and Fulvestrant. [](https://in.linkedin.com/company/swasthya-healthcare)

- **Critical Care & Injectables:** Enoxaparin Sodium, Amphotericin B Liposomal injection, Filgrastim, and Cytarabine. [](https://in.linkedin.com/company/swasthya-healthcare)

- **Nephrology & Hormonal Therapies:** Erythropoietin, Teriparatide injection (pre-filled pens), Goserelin Acetate, and Conjugated Estrogen Vaginal Cream. [](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/swasthya-healthcare_swasthya-healthcare-is-a-trusted-name-in-activity-7474798032518262784-6cmp)

- **Contrast Media & Imaging:** Iohexol, Iopamidol, Gadopentetate Dimeglumine, and Iodixanol. [](https://www.swasthyahealthcare.com/)

- **Antiretrovirals (ARV) & Metabolic:** Sofosbuvir/Velpatasvir film-coated tablets, alongside generalized cardiovascular, antibiotic, and anti-inflammatory lines. [](https://www.swasthyahealthcare.com/)

- **Specialized Delivery Systems:** Dry powder inhalers (DPIs) and nasal sprays. [](https://in.linkedin.com/company/swasthya-healthcare)

### Manufacturer Partners & Network Structure

- **Manufacturing Partners:** Operates via a robust outsourcing and partnership network of **over 100 verified and accredited manufacturing sites** across India and internationally that meet stringent regulatory compliance (WHO-GMP/DCGI). [](https://swasthyahealthcare.com/facilities.php)

- **Global Infrastructure:** Facilitates worldwide distribution via international corporate branch offices located in **Dubai (UAE), Singapore, and Guatemala (Central America)**. [](https://www.swasthyahealthcare.com/contact-us.php)

- **Ecosystem Distinction:** While _Swasthya Healthcare_ manages institutional, export, and high-end critical care formulations, it is structurally distinct from domestic consumer-facing generic networks like _Generic Aadhaar_ (associated with the broader Deshpande family enterprise). [](https://www.swasthyahealthcare.com
